name: verse-embedded
description: Lightweight library for embedding Verse artwork iframes

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/verse-embedded.js --minify --sourcemap && esbuild src/elements.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/verse-elements.js --minify --sourcemap && cp dist/verse-embedded.js dist/verse-embedded.js.map dist/verse-elements.js dist/verse-elements.js.map public/
scripts.dev: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/verse-embedded.js --sourcemap --watch & esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --outfile=public/verse-embedded.js --sourcemap --watch & esbuild src/elements.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/verse-elements.js --sourcemap --watch & esbuild src/elements.ts --bundle --outfile=public/verse-elements.js --sourcemap --watch
